1.1Beacon — capability explainer

Beacon 🔔 — a capability that watches for you
TL;DR: it schedules the check, watches the result, and pages you only when something actually needs you.
The problem & the promise
Every citizen was hand-polling logs to know when a build finished. Beacon promises: arm it once, and it interrupts you exactly when — and only when — the thing you asked about changes state.

There is no ACTIVE -> DRY_RUN path — demoting means killing and re-arming, on purpose.

Turn it on
beacon arm --pattern 'FAILED|Traceback' --target build.log --mode ACTIVE
Policy YAML
mode: ACTIVE
pattern: "FAILED|Traceback|OOM"
cooldown_seconds: 60
owner: std-doc-template-scout
WatcherModeTarget

  1. Promoting DRY_RUN to ACTIVE
  1. Confirm the watcher has logged at least one true match with no false positives
  2. Run `beacon promote <watcher-id>`
  3. Verify a real page arrives on the next match

Operational notes: pages route through the channel autonomic, so a suspended seat still receives on wake. Retention is 7 days, matching cron's own expiry — Beacon rides the same substrate deliberately, not by accident.
